title: Why 90% of AI Hacks Are Not the AI's Fault
description:
90% of AI systems that get hacked? Its people, not the tech 😅

IBM looked at 600 companies hit by AI incidents this year. 92% had no basic access controls set up. And the attacks dont land on the model, they hit APIs and cloud services.

Average AI breach: $5M. Basically same as a regular attack with zero AI in it 🔥 The threat isnt new, the discipline is just missing.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
